title: Der Panzerrechnersimulator historical environmental-storytelling scenes
doctrine: Tell one coherent anti-war story without spoken or written exposition, exclusively through sourced environments, objects, damage, absence, weather, sound, and movement traces.
historical_integrity_boundary: Source truth attaches to each tableau, not automatically to the player's Tiger, route adjacency, or compressed chronology. The campaign journey is a fictional composite unless separately validated; no catalog entry implies that one crew witnessed every scene or that generated neighbors were historical neighbors.

provenance_classes.exact_landmark: Fixed to the attested landmark or an explicitly declared campaign-scale representation of it; never a freely movable encounter tile.
provenance_classes.district_event: Movable only inside the named district, route, battlefield zone, or biome envelope supported by the source.
provenance_classes.attested_condition: Movable within compatible campaign biomes, but never represented as the exact photographed or witnessed location.
